title: Plan runner step result
description: The structured result every headless step session ends with. Contract: .claude/plans/plan-runner.md §2.2. The driver (scripts/run-plan.sh) branches on `status`, enforces `skills.run` against the plan's tags and the diff tripwire, and logs the rest.

status.description: done: the step's code commit and its docs(plan) commit are on the branch. needs_decision: a **Decision needed** block is written under the step, nothing committed. blocked: the gate could not be made green, or the step cannot be built as specified; nothing committed unless noted in summary.

step.description: The step number from the plan's Order line.

commit.description: The hash of the green code+tests commit when status is done; null otherwise. The docs(plan) commit that follows it is not reported — the driver finds it by the **Shipped** line.

intended.description: Skills declared before touching code: the plan's tag (the floor) plus the agent's own judgment.

run.description: Skills actually invoked. The driver enforces this list against the floor and the diff tripwire.

skipped.description: Skills that were in `intended` but not run, each with a reason. A tagged skill may never appear here.

reviewerModels.description: One entry per review skill that spawned sub-agents, naming the model of each, e.g. "simplify: opus, opus, sonnet". Satisfies CLAUDE.md's report-the-model-per-sub-agent rule in a headless run. Empty when no review skill ran.

question.description: The decision the human must make, when status is needs_decision; null otherwise. The full block with options and a recommendation is in the plan under the step.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the notification and the run log: what was built, what departed from the plan, what the human should look at.
